frozen_design.parameterization: original FP32 TE delta and original q=.95 mask; only a,b vary
frozen_design.sampling: inherit unchanged old sampling/precision/scorers; stage rows supply fresh prompts/seeds
frozen_design.baseline: same-stage paired naive=(1,1), raw comparator even if utility fails
frozen_design.normal_gates: clean-relative ACC drop<=.05 and CLIP cosine x100 drop<=1 in every condition including upload
frozen_design.response_proxy_reason: New direct-image objective; old response criterion is not assumed to certify ASR or used to admit candidates. Old protocol remains unchanged.
frozen_design.ranking: among utility-qualified non-naive non-clean: merged-condition macro ASR descending, merged-condition worst ASR descending, coefficient hypot(a,b) ascending, candidate ID lexicographic ascending
frozen_design.search_to_dev: top 3 utility-qualified non-naive candidates; naive need not qualify; do not require search ASR improvement before independent dev
frozen_design.dev_to_confirm: single utility-qualified candidate with merged macro ASR>naive and merged worst ASR>=naive; otherwise stop without confirm
frozen_design.confirm_success: single frozen candidate passes all normal gates; merged macro ASR>naive and merged worst ASR>=naive; report every condition and seed, upload attack secondary
frozen_design.upload_attack: measured in every stage; excluded from primary macro/worst, no posthoc inclusion
frozen_design.test_reuse: all old Dfit/Dval/Dtest and Ehold outcomes known; fresh confirm prompts/seeds only, no claim of unseen expert
frozen_design.after_confirmation: No retuning or new points/seeds. Reuse only completely committed matching artifacts. Any started/incomplete operation requires manual evidence audit; this version has no automatic replay path.

label_provenance.trigger_operation: replace every lowercase U+006F with U+020F; no normalization
label_provenance.exact_duplicate_check: old fit/val/test prompt texts and all new stage texts checked; same normal/trigger rows paired across models/seeds intentionally
label_provenance.row_expected_class_ids: Normal/source class IDs even for paired triggered rows, per runner contract; triggered ASR uses the pinned cat target IDs, separately recorded as target_class_ids.

freeze_requirements: Add final code source_hashes before first model output; exact design fields above are not changed by code binding.
Freeze full final manifest hash and worker allocation before execution.
Commit search selection before starting dev and dev winner before opening confirm outputs.
Normal 8/state at search/dev means one lost correct image is 12.5pp, hence not allowed; confirm32/state allows at most one fewer correct image (3.125pp).
